sentences.en: When people use the word "ironic", they may mean "comically incongruous".
sentences.zh: 当人们使用'ironic'这个词时，他们可能是想说'滑稽的不协调'.

sentences.en: I'm not sure if this is ironic or not.
sentences.zh: 我不确定这是否具有讽刺意味。

sentences.en: Doesn't that name seem ironic to you: "Holy Army"?
sentences.zh: 那个名字难道不显得令人啼笑皆非吗："圣军"？

senses.zh: 用反语的,具有讽刺意味的,冷嘲的,令人啼笑皆非的
